# Om Tiwari

> Official website and portfolio of Om Tiwari, a Cloud Architect and Software Engineer based in Indore, India. Specializing in Python, Django, AWS Cloud Architecture, DevOps Pipelines (Docker & Kubernetes), and Agentic AI.

## Canonical Domain
- https://omtiwari.dev

- [About](https://omtiwari.dev/about.html): Background, education timeline at Medi-Caps University, and AWS & AI certifications.
- [Projects](https://omtiwari.dev/projects.html): Production systems including Kubernetes manufacturing deployment, live cricket WinPulse analytics, and multi-agent AI.
- [Resume](https://omtiwari.dev/resume.html): Comprehensive technical resume, skill breakdown, and credential verifications.
- [Contact](https://omtiwari.dev/contact.html): Official communication channels and social links.
